title: Give an Update & Give Information
objective: Use give an update and give information to report progress clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: At the start of the shift, I give an update about my tasks.
dialogue.indonesian: Di awal shift, saya memberi kabar terbaru tentang tugas-tugas saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I give an update to my supervisor after the check.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya memberi kabar terbaru kepada supervisor setelah pemeriksaan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: The update gives information about the machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Kabar terbaru itu memberi informasi tentang mesin.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Please give information about the problem before you leave.
dialogue.indonesian: Tolong beri informasi tentang masalahnya sebelum Anda pergi.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Clear information helps the team plan the next step.
dialogue.indonesian: Informasi yang jelas membantu tim merencanakan langkah berikutnya.

learningNotes: give an update berarti memberi kabar terbaru tentang pekerjaan atau situasi.
Information tidak berubah menjadi informations. Gunakan some information atau a piece of information.
Gunakan give an update to + orang: give an update to my supervisor.
